“One AI tool did something in 2 days that used to take me 2 months.” This AI Tool Saved Me 2 Months - That was the moment Raul realised — AI is not just a technology, it’s a speed revolution. This part of the conversation is very important because it explains what AI actually changes.

Most people think AI is just about chatbots, images, or content.
But the real power of AI is speed.
It changes how fast you can create, build, learn, and execute.
And in today’s world, speed is a superpower.

🎙️ In this clip, Raul talks about discovering an AI video editing tool called Firecut.

Before AI:
• Video editing took weeks
• Cutting, trimming, subtitles, effects — everything manual
• Creating content was slow and time-consuming

After AI:
• Editing became automated
• Subtitles generated automatically
• Cuts and silences removed automatically
• Videos created much faster

And that’s when he realised something very important:

💡 AI doesn’t just make things easier.
AI makes things faster.

And the people who move faster learn faster, build faster, and grow faster.

🧠 KEY TAKEAWAY
The AI revolution is not just about intelligence.
It’s about speed.
The future will belong to people who can:
• Learn faster
• Build faster
• Execute faster
• Adapt faster

And AI is the tool that makes that possible.
